messages:
incident-bot: P1 Pager — GPU pool saturation in gcp-uk-south. queue_length=1287, pending_requests=540, autoscaler_error=quotaExceeded. Paging on-call now.

carmen.ng: grabbing it — on-call. first look: autoscaler hitting region quota limits when attempting to add n1-standard-gpu instances.

ben.m: +1 seeing failed LB drain retries, some user requests 503'ing. can we confirm which customers impacted? support-ops?

support-ops: customer-impact: several low-latency customers (team-prod & search-qa) reporting elevated 5xx and slowed responses. Opened internal ticket PROD-4219.

sre-lead: quick triage plan: 1) confirm quota error in cloud logs 2) try fallback routing to eu-west2 3) launch reserve preemptible pool if possible 4) notify customers.

infra-naz: checking quota now — running gcloud:
```
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west2 --project=redwood-prod
# look for quotas: GPUs (NVIDIA_TESLA_T4) -> usage 96 / limit 96
```

infra-naz: confirmed: GPUs at 100% for europe-west2 too. gcp-uk-south trying to provision hit org-level limit: GPU quota hard cap.

carmen.ng: autoscaler logs: "scaleUp: instanceGroupManagers.resize failed: quotaExceeded". Pasting snippet:
```
ERROR autoscaler: failed to increase targetSize from 20 to 30: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for 'projects/XXXX'
```

ben.m: can we temporarily reduce batch worker concurrency to buy time? any routes we can degrade gracefully?

product-ops: recommend enabling token-rate-limit on non-critical routes and divert background batch jobs to offline queue. We'll push a feature flag to lower concurrency.

sre-lead: doing a canary config change to reduce max_concurrency from 16 -> 4 for background routes. Carmen, coordinate the rollback window.

carmen.ng: applying canary now. gating traffic to eu-west1 for critical flows via failover policy.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by carmen.ng: config/service: background-worker concurrency patch -> canary -> rolling.

infra-naz: temporary workaround: requested emergency GPU quota raise with GCP support (case 10987432). ETA unknown (~2-6 hours). Also provisioning a cold spare pool in aws-eu-west to accept reroutes — requires infra approvals.

ben.m: starting reroute rule update to prefer aws-eu-west GPUs for new sessions. will be gradual to avoid double-billing.

support-ops: customer comms draft: "We are experiencing capacity constraints in the Europe region affecting inference latency. We're actively rerouting and scaling; we'll update in 30m." Approve? :warning:

product-ops: approve. include mitigation steps and expected ETA for transparent status.

sre-lead: handoff plan: if quota not increased in 30m escalate to escalation-manager for cross-org quota lift. Carmen will stay 1hr then hand to Ben for night shift.

carmen.ng: ack. Logging current metrics to incident channel and adding runbook link. Runbook snippet: https://intra/redwood/runbooks/gpu-quota-exhaustion

infra-naz: next_action: 1) monitor reroute success 2) push preemptible pool 3) escalate quota with GCP. Updating last checked metrics: queue_length=922, pending_requests=310 (after initial changes).

ben.m: standing by to take over at 18:00 UTC. If queue doesn't drop below 200 by then we start customer tiered throttles.

incident-bot: incident update — severity still P1. Latest queue_length=740. Next update in 15m or on major change.
